t: This one is a little different: it's a drawing, not a building. It's a study for the east façade of the Louvre in Paris, from the first project, by Gian Lorenzo Bernini. Bernini was an Italian sculptor, architect, painter and city planner, and he is credited with creating the Baroque style of sculpture. He was also a major figure in architecture, and this sheet shows his mind at work on one of the most famous palace fronts in Europe. Think of it as a glimpse of an idea on paper, before any stone was cut.
